zh.title: 修复设置与面板切换
zh.summary: 修复设置页空白和面板切换失去响应的问题。

items.text: 重开收藏对比或切换日期、机位、数据源时，立即禁用自选时段输入并重新确认当地时间，避免加载期间沿用旧机位的时间上下文。
收藏机位对比新增整天、目标窗口和自选时段，用于同一时区的机位，可比较无月、银河或日落前后条件，并展开查看原始云量、风速与累计降水；跨午夜时标注日期，修正时段行分隔线；Open-Meteo 简写为 OM，顶部标签精简为“数据源”“时段”，与目标窗口紧凑排列。
调整语言选择框的箭头与右侧边框间距，统一箭头样式并保持文字居中。
事件时刻标签按各语言的完整语序显示，避免事件名与“时间”粘连；修正部分天气、天空盘、收藏排序和功能说明的译名与语法，并同步相关入口和说明引用。
修正孟加拉语降水、荷兰语中层云、日语和韩语彩虹方向图的译名，并统一丹麦语与挪威语的地图方位线术语，避免误解为行为准则。
精简日语「关于」标签和更新徽标，修正日语天气、云层表头与说明，以及部分语言把事件倒计时译成「下一步」的问题。
明确所有语言中最小化选项同时隐藏的内容；修正所选日期被写为“今天”的提示，并补全光污染排序、直线距离、中国搜索 API Key 及临时英语恢复的说明，统一不透明度名称。
简体中文和英语保持内置，其他语言改为首次使用时按需下载并缓存，减少插件下载体积；启动加载失败可重试或临时使用英语，保留原语言偏好。
支持 Windy 设置中的 42 种语言，默认跟随 Windy；也可在设置顶部单独选择并记住语言，或切回跟随。语言列表优先显示简体中文、繁体中文和英语。新增语言的机器初译已进行术语与语义复核，尚未逐语言由母语者人工审校；说明图片与历史更新说明仍使用中文或英文。
修复窄屏下较长的功能标签相互重叠、遮挡相邻按钮的问题，完整显示文字并保留规划下拉箭头的操作空间。
修复 Windy 新增飞行危险图层后设置页空白、切换云层和关于失去响应的问题。
启动图层选项支持飞行危险，并只展示插件支持且当前 Windy 提供的图层。

en.title: Settings and panel navigation fixes
en.summary: Fixed blank Settings and unresponsive panel navigation.

items.text: Reopening comparisons or changing dates, sites or data sources now immediately disables custom-period inputs until local time is confirmed again, preventing the previous site's time context from being used during loading.

Favorite comparisons now support whole days, target windows and custom periods for sites in one time zone, with moonless, Milky Way or sunset conditions and original cloud, wind and accumulated precipitation samples. Dates mark midnight crossings and period-row borders are aligned. Open-Meteo is shortened to OM; compact Data source and Period labels share a toolbar with the target-window selector.
Adjusted the language selector’s arrow spacing from the right edge, matching other navigation arrows while keeping the label centered.

Event-time labels now follow each language’s word order and spacing. Corrected terminology and grammar in weather, sky charts, favorite sorting and feature guidance, with matching control labels and guide references.

Corrected Bengali precipitation, Dutch mid-level cloud and Japanese/Korean rainbow direction-chart labels. Clarified map azimuth-line terminology in Danish and Norwegian so it is not confused with guidelines.
Shortened the Japanese About tab and update badge, corrected Japanese weather labels and explanations, and fixed event countdown labels translated as a navigation action in several languages.

Clarified what each minimize option hides in every language. Fixed messages that called the selected date “today”, and clarified light-pollution sorting, straight-line distance, China search API keys and temporary English recovery. Chinese opacity labels now match the controls.

Simplified Chinese and English remain built in. Other languages download individually on first use and are cached, reducing plugin size. Retry a failed startup load or temporarily use English while keeping your saved preference.

Supports the 42 languages in Windy Settings and follows Windy by default. Choose and remember a separate language at the top of Settings, or switch back to following Windy. Manual language choices start with Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese and English, in that order. Machine translations for new languages have received terminology and semantic checks, but not human native-speaker review in every language; guide images and historical update notes remain in Chinese or English.
Fixed long tab labels overlapping and blocking adjacent buttons on narrow screens. Labels remain fully visible and the planning dropdown arrow retains its own space.
Fixed blank Settings and unresponsive Clouds/About navigation after Windy introduced the Flight dangers layer.
Startup layer choices now include Flight dangers and only list layers supported by the plugin and available in Windy.
